text:
maria: FinServX just replied to our presales doc — they're insisting on BYO KMS (CloudHSM) for the POC and need an explicit plan for key rotation, dual-custody cutover, and a checklist for auditors. Also stuck on pricing: they want the POC (90 days) to be cheaper if they bring their HSMs. cc @aaron @jessica @ben

aaron: We can run the POC with customer-managed HSMs. Two deployment patterns: 1) proxy-mode where our service calls their KMS endpoints, 2) wrap-mode where they export a wrapped CEK and we never call their KMS at runtime. Latency: proxy adds ~3-8ms per token call depending on region and retries. I'll verify with infra for their eu-west-1 setup.

jessica: Auditor asks: "do you ever persist key material?" Short answer: no. We store only key IDs and envelopes. I'll attach our KMS custody diagram and an attestation excerpt. Also note: for zero-downtime rotation we recommend staged key roll using wrap/unwrap and traffic-shift with canary verification.

sec-bot: New upload: finservx_sec_qa_2026.pdf (uploaded by maria).

maria: They want rotation at 02:00 local (they're UTC+2) every 30 days. They also asked whether we can run rotation dry-runs in staging with their dev keys.

ben: Pricing: If customer BYO-HSM AND performs local wrapping for the POC, ops overhead drops significantly. We can offer 15% off Dedicated POC fees (one-time), and waive ingress data egress fees for the trial. Legal requires a customer-managed-key addendum (CMK Addendum).

elena: I'll prep the addendum and a short Acknowledgment for auditors: it will state we never log plaintext key material, list the audit certs we can share (e.g., HSM attestation, KMS API audit trails), and define liability boundaries.

jessica: Network/runbook details for both paths:
- proxy-mode: our hosts need outbound 443 to their KMS endpoints, TLS mutual auth optional.
- wrap-mode: only initial key exchange; afterwards no runtime KMS calls.
Example firewall snippet for customer:
```yaml
outbound:
  - to: kms.customer.net:443
  - proto: TCP
  - ntp: 123/udp
```
Rotation test script (staging):
```bash
# run as customer-admin
curl -X POST https://kms.customer.net/rotate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
./test_rotation.sh --verify-canary
```

jessica: I'll attach the custody diagram and a one-page rotation playbook by COB.

maria: They also want to know rollback procedures if a rotation fails mid-cutover. Can we confirm fallback to previous CEK and toggle traffic?

aaron: Yes — our rollout supports traffic-split with immediate rollback to previous key ID. For safety we require the customer provide the previous key's unwrap API credential during the POC acceptance test. We'll document the acceptance criteria.

ben: Follow-ups for pricing/legal: 1) ben to send POC quote with BYO discount, 2) elena to share CMK Addendum draft, 3) jessica to push diagrams/runbook. Maria please confirm customer will provide: KMS endpoints, API creds for rotation tests, and attestation cert (if on-prem).

maria: Confirmed. I'll ask FinServX to provide the endpoints and attestation PDFs. Target: internal handoff meeting next Monday 10am PT. Everyone available?

elena: I can do it.

aaron: Works for infra to check latency on Friday and ping back.

jessica: I'll upload artifacts EOD and include a brief checklist for auditors.

ben: I'll draft the quote and include the 15% BYO POC line item.

maria: Thanks team :thumbsup:
